svg.aria-label: How it works, as a moving pipeline: your product brief, documents or website become a product profile and a local knowledge graph; simulated buyers are interviewed and given decision cards; they see your ads in six feeds and talk in OASIS social rounds; a survey turns their free text into 1-5 ratings with semantic similarity rating and a pitch collects objections; the report gives go, iterate or no-go with an offline dashboard. Real results then come back for backtests and calibration, and feed the next experiment. One command, market-test, runs the stages from one config.

svg.text: One command, market-test, runs the stages from one config. Every output is saved in the run folder.

g.text: 6. Check against reality: backtest, calibrate, next experiment

svg.text: A go is a simulation signal, not a sales guarantee.
